set_th_config: set random seeds for numpy, torch, and cuda to ensure deterministic training runs
filter_checkpoints: filter old model checkpoint files in a directory keeping only the latest five checkpoints
get_last_checkpoint: get the path of the most recent model checkpoint file from a given directory
convert_length_to_mask: convert a tensor of sequence lengths into a binary attention mask tensor
eval_test: run evaluation on a model using a data loader and compare predictions against ground truth
